about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Your Tech Guide
about.paragraph1: Hi! I'm Paweł, a business process optimization expert and automation specialist. As a Technical Lead at Tigers/Automation House, I help companies with digital transformation through intelligent technology selection and implementation of no-code and AI solutions.
about.paragraph2: My IT journey started in 2008 with .NET and SQL Server programming. Over the years, I developed medical systems, served as CTO at the ShareFund startup, and managed IT projects. Today, I combine programming experience with modern automation tools, creating systems that truly solve business problems.
about.paragraph3: I'm a technology agnostic - I match tools to the problem, not the problem to tools. I use Make, n8n, Airtable, AI (OpenAI, Claude), Python, and many other technologies to deliver optimal solutions. I share knowledge through consulting, workshops, and technical articles.
